channel.title: Pier & Point · 1470 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1470 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: 23 routine building permits (alterations, revisions, deferred…
item.description: 23 routine building permits (alterations, revisions, deferred submittals, fire or utility work and similar) now appear under Building permits in this record's research notes instead of on its timeline. 10 permit cost figures now show as the valuation of the matching permit entries under Building permits, not under Costs. Earlier change-log entries about these permits stay in the log until it is archived at launch. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The cable-barrier installation…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The cable-barrier installation permit's cost was revised to $65,000." says the permit's cost was revised. DataSF DBI Building Permits, permit 201904178265: "estimated_cost":"65000.0","revised_cost":"65000.0". The two fields are equal, so the figure is the permit's declared valuation, not a revised or actual construction cost. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=201904178265.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says a permit for "two temporary…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says a permit for "two temporary trailers" was completed (2022-08-09). DataSF, permit 202205023408: "description":"temporary(2) construction of trailers on the roof of adjacement parking garage at 1470 owens st.","status":"complete","completed_date":"2022-08-09". The "(2)" could be a count or another code; the number of trailers is not stated. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=202205023408.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The parking garage's permit carried…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) "The parking garage's permit carried a $6,000,000 valuation, unchanged from filing" says the designer's page gives $22,400,000 but its source column lists only the permit. Watry Design, 1470 Owens Parking Structure: "Project Status: Completed 2020 Parking Stalls: 317 Levels: 4 ... Total Project Cost: $22,400,000". This is a designer-reported total, not a DBI figure. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012…
item.description: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012 completion, 10 stories and 627 stalls for what it calls the Owens Street Parking Structure, with no street number. Watry Design lists 1470 Owens as completed in 2020 with 4 levels and 317 stalls, so the WRNS page is treated as a different building; which building it depicts is not confirmed. Source: https://wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/ ; https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: The record now says the garage was designed by Watry Design and…
item.description: The record now says the garage was designed by Watry Design and serves UCSF life-science buildings and Kaiser's medical offices. Before, it called it a UCSF parking structure designed by WRNS Studio, but Watry's own page names Watry as designer and lists the owner only as 'Developer'. The map use changed from institutional to commercial (the Assessor's class). The unsourced Kaiser address was dropped, the Assessor citation now points at the record for this parcel, the ERRCS administrative permit no longer carries a 'planned' status, permit descriptions no longer place every added security item on levels 2-4 (DBI places only the blue phones there), the $6,000,000 permit figure is described as the permit's unrevised valuation, and the aerial photo's caption and credit no longer say 'from a departing flight', which the Commons page does not state (the photographer's name is now cited to his Commons user page). Source: Watry Design, 1470 Owens Parking Structure (https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8709019 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8709019); DBI permit 201910316042 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/dbipts/?page=Permit&PermitNumber=201910316042); DBI permit 201806010826 (https://dbiweb02.sfgov.org/dbipts/?page=Permit&PermitNumber=201806010826); Wikimedia Commons, User:Firstcultural (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Firstcultural).

item.title: Added · 1470 Owens Street: 1470 Owens Street added as a parcel-backed record: a parking structure…
item.description: 1470 Owens Street added as a parcel-backed record: a parking structure (designed by Watry Design, per its own project page) serving nearby UCSF life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices, identified during the same positioning review. Confirmed via the designer's own project page and a parking-facility listing. DataSF's Building Footprints layer has no footprint at all for this parcel, so the Assessor parcel boundary is used directly. Source: Watry Design, 1470 Owens Parking Structure (https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure); ParkChirp, 1470 Owens Parking (https://parkchirp.com/facilities/1470-owens-parking/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8709019 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8709019); DataSF Building Footprints (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Building-Footprints/ynuv-fyni).
